answer_1.quote: Image Difference Captioning (IDC) requires a model to generate natural-language descriptions that highlight salient differences between a pair of visually similar images.
answer_1.outputs: natural-language descriptions that highlight salient differences between a pair of visually similar images

answer_2.quote: Following previous IDC works , we use the standard evaluation protocol to evaluate the image difference captioning quality with metrics including BLEU-4 (B4) , ME-TEOR (M) , ROUGE-L (R)  and CIDEr-D (C) .

answer_4.quote: We assessed the degree of difference for 100 randomly selected image pairs on a scale from 1 (completely different) to 5 (almost identical) by both human evaluators and GPT-4o.
answer_4.guideline: a scale from 1 (completely different) to 5 (almost identical)
